name: golangci-lint
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:

permissions:
  contents: read
  # Optional: allow read access to pull request. Use with `only-new-issues` option.
  # pull-requests: read

jobs:
  golangci:
    name: lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v7
        with:
          go-version-file: 'go.mod'
          cache: false
      - name: golangci-lint
        uses: golangci/golangci-lint-action@v9
        with:
          # Require: The version of golangci-lint to use.
          # When `install-mode` is `binary` (default) the value can be v1.2 or v1.2.3 or `latest` to use the latest version.
          # When `install-mode` is `goinstall` the value can be v1.2.3, `latest`, or the hash of a commit.
          version: v2.14.0

          # Optional: working directory, useful for monorepos
          # working-directory: somedir

          # Optional: golangci-lint command line arguments.
          #
          # Note: By default, the `.golangci.yml` file should be at the root of the repository.
          # The location of the configuration file can be changed by using `--config=`
          # args: --timeout=30m --config=/my/path/.golangci.yml --issues-exit-code=0

          # Optional: show only new issues if it's a pull request. The default value is `false`.
          # only-new-issues: true

          # Optional: if set to true, then all caching functionality will be completely disabled,
          #           takes precedence over all other caching options.
          # skip-cache: true

          # Optional: if set to true, then the action won't cache or restore ~/go/pkg.
          # skip-pkg-cache: true

          # Optional: if set to true, then the action won't cache or restore ~/.cache/go-build.
          # skip-build-cache: true

          # Optional: The mode to install golangci-lint. It can be 'binary' or 'goinstall'.
          # install-mode: "goinstall"

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check

Assess skip explicitly dispensable workflow runs for this repository, preserve its required checks, and propose a minimal change or NO_CHANGE.
